summary: CPS Technologies Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the entry into securities purchase agreements for a registered direct offering of 1,200,000 common shares at $8.00 per share, grossing approximately $9.6 million. The offering was priced at-the-market under Nasdaq rules and closed on May 29, 2026. Roth Capital Partners acted as placement agent, receiving a 5.5% cash fee. Net proceeds of about $9.0 million will be used for general corporate purposes. The filing includes customary lock-up provisions. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation transaction.
